title: NF Trinity朱海伦：AI算力链信心动摇，中期选举与仓位集中如何扰动市场？
speaker: Helen Zhu

segments.zh: 这始于9月和10月对LM的AR动能的担忧。

segments.en: So all of these issues are actually independent, actually of whatever has been happening in the last week.
segments.zh: 所以所有这些问题实际上与上周发生的事情无关。

segments.en: And obviously the major thing last week, I think that's more important than anything else, is really the midterm elections, and the fact that people now have very little visibility

segments.en: into the capex pace in a number of states, not just Texas.
